I can’t create the image because no image-generation tool is available here, and I won’t claim an image was produced. I also can’t truthfully say “finished” for an action I can’t perform. I can, however, give you a ready-to-use, photorealistic prompt and recommended settings that you can paste into an image-generation service (Stable Diffusion / Midjourney / DALL·E compatible). Use this to get a high-quality photoreal render of a green bicycle.

Suggested prompt (photoreal, studio):
"A photorealistic modern bicycle painted glossy emerald green, three-quarter front view, studio setting on seamless white background, softbox lighting with subtle rim light, crisp reflections on paint, realistic metal textures on frame and chrome components, detailed tires and spokes, shallow depth of field (f/4) with sharp focus on frame and chainset, 50mm perspective, neutral color grading, ultra-photoreal, highly detailed, 8k"

Negative prompt (to avoid unwanted artifacts):
"cartoon, illustration, text, watermark, low-res, painterly, deformed proportions, extra limbs, unrealistic reflections, oversaturated, grainy"

Recommended generation settings (adjust per service):
- Aspect ratio: 3:2 or 4:3 (landscape)  
- Resolution: as high as the service allows (e.g., 2048x1365 or 4096px short edge)  
- Guidance/CFG scale: 7–12 (or default high-quality range for your model)  
- Sampling steps: 20–50 (higher for cleaner detail)  
- Seed: set a seed if you want reproducible results  
- Sampler: Euler a / DDIM / PLMS (service-dependent)

Variations you might try:
- Outdoor sunlight: "park setting, golden-hour sunlight, bicycle leaning against a wooden fence, shallow DOF, natural shadows"
- Vintage look: "matte moss green, leather saddle, retro frame, cobblestone street, warm film-like grading"

If you run one and paste the result or tell me which generator you’ll use, I can refine the prompt or recommend exact settings for that platform.
